perks.name: Augmented Servos
perks.description: Powered melees release an additional disorienting pulse when used to defeat a target.
perks.exact:
On Powered Melee Kill:
Target releases a Disorienting Pulse over 10 meters after 0.67 seconds of dying.
Disorienting Pulse inflicts Disorient for 2.5 seconds.
Incurs a 0.5? second cooldown between triggers.

perks.name: God-like Judgment
perks.description: When your shields are broken by a combatant, or upon casting your Super, release a swarm of heat seeking micro-missiles.
perks.exact:
Upon reaching Critical Health through Combatant Damage, or on Super Cast:
Fires multiple Seeking Micro-Missiles, each dealing Class-based [31] Kinetic Damage.
Critical Health = 2 Missiles | Super Cast = 4 Missiles

Hunters = 217 Damage | Titan = 680 Damage | Warlocks = 217 Damage
